Tomato___Early_blight.organic_treatment: Apply copper octanoate (copper soap) or Bacillus subtilis bio-fungicide at first sign of target-like concentric rings on lower leaves. Remove and destroy infected bottom foliage; mulch soil to prevent rain splashback.
Tomato___Early_blight.chemical_treatment: Azoxystrobin or Chlorothalonil fungicide class. Follow local label directions and statutory pre-harvest intervals.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Stake plants for air circulation, avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation, maintain 3-year solanaceous crop rotation.
Tomato___Early_blight.risk_factors: Warm temperatures (24–29°C) accompanied by extended leaf wetness or high humidity (>80%).

Tomato___Late_blight.organic_treatment: Fixed copper hydroxide sprays applied preventatively before rain events. Promptly rogued and bag infected plants; do not compost.
Tomato___Late_blight.chemical_treatment: Metalaxyl-M or Cymoxanil active ingredient formulations. Follow local label instructions and resistance management guidelines.
Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Plant certified disease-free transplants, ensure wide row spacing, monitor regional blight forecast warnings.
Tomato___Late_blight.risk_factors: Cool, humid weather (15–22°C with persistent fog, mist, or rain).

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.organic_treatment: Liquid copper bactericide combined with Bacillus amyloliquefaciens. Spray during cool morning hours; avoid working in wet foliage.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.chemical_treatment: Copper hydroxide mixed with Mancozeb (protectant). Follow manufacturer label safety regulations.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use hot water-treated seed, rotate away from peppers and tomatoes for 2 years, eliminate volunteer nightshades.

Potato___Late_blight.organic_treatment: Bordeaux mixture (copper sulfate + slaked lime) or copper oxychloride. Destroy cull piles immediately.
Potato___Late_blight.chemical_treatment: Fluopicolide or Dimethomorph active ingredient class. Adhere strictly to local agricultural authority guidelines.
Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Plant certified seed tubers, hill rows well to protect developing tubers from washing spores, destroy vines 2 weeks before harvest.

Potato___Early_blight.organic_treatment: Neem oil formulation or Trichoderma viride biological spray. Ensure adequate nitrogen and potassium to reduce plant stress.
Potato___Early_blight.chemical_treatment: Difenoconazole or Mancozeb active ingredient class. Always follow local label and protective gear guidelines.
Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Maintain balanced crop nutrition, irrigate early in the morning so canopy dries quickly.
Potato___Early_blight.risk_factors: Alternating wet and dry periods with temperatures around 25°C.

Corn___Common_rust.organic_treatment: Apply sulfur-based wettable powder or potassium bicarbonate spray at early vegetative stage if pustules appear.
Corn___Common_rust.chemical_treatment: Pyraclostrobin or Propiconazole triazole class. Apply only if disease reaches economic threshold before tasseling; follow regional regulations.
Corn___Common_rust.prevention: Select resistant hybrids (Rp-resistant gene varieties), destroy infected crop residue after harvest.
Corn___Common_rust.risk_factors: Moderate temperatures (16–25°C) with high relative humidity and dew.

Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.organic_treatment: Bacillus pumilus bio-fungicide or copper soap. Plow under crop debris immediately following harvest.
Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.chemical_treatment: Azoxystrobin + Propiconazole formulation. Consult local pesticide registrar for approved timing.
Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.prevention: Rotate with non-host crops (soybean, peanut), plant tolerant hybrids, maintain balanced fertilization.
Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.risk_factors: Wet weather with moderate temperatures (18–27°C) and heavy dews.

Grape___Black_rot.organic_treatment: Lime-sulfur during dormant season; copper octanoate sprays from early shoot growth through fruit set.
Grape___Black_rot.chemical_treatment: Myclobutanil or Tebuconazole active class. Follow vineyard pre-harvest limits.
Grape___Black_rot.prevention: Prune mummified berries from vines and ground, orient vine rows with prevailing winds for rapid canopy drying.
Grape___Black_rot.risk_factors: Warm, rainy spring and early summer weather (21–27°C).

Apple___Apple_scab.organic_treatment: Sulfur or potassium bicarbonate sprays during green-tip through bloom stages. Rake and compost fallen leaves with nitrogen to accelerate breakdown.
Apple___Apple_scab.chemical_treatment: Flusilazole or Captan active ingredient class. Follow local orchard spray schedules.
Apple___Apple_scab.prevention: Prune canopy annually for open structure, plant scab-resistant cultivars (e.g. Liberty, Enterprise).
Apple___Apple_scab.risk_factors: Wet spring weather with continuous leaf wetness of 6–10 hours.

Wheat___Leaf_rust.organic_treatment: Sulfur dust (80% WP) or Trichoderma viride biological antagonist. Avoid excess nitrogen top-dressing which promotes lush vegetative tissue.
Wheat___Leaf_rust.chemical_treatment: Propiconazole (25% EC) or Tebuconazole triazole class. Spray when flag leaf shows >5% pustule incidence; obey local label instructions.
Wheat___Leaf_rust.prevention: Sow rust-resistant certified varieties (e.g. HD-2967, DBW-187), eliminate volunteer wheat grasses.
Wheat___Leaf_rust.risk_factors: Temperatures 15–25°C accompanied by light morning rains or persistent dew.

Rice___Blast.organic_treatment: Pseudomonas fluorescens seed treatment (10g/kg) and foliar bio-spray. Drain paddy water for 48 hours to reduce canopy micro-humidity.
Rice___Blast.chemical_treatment: Tricyclazole (75% WP) or Kasugamycin class. Spray at early tillering and panicle emergence; follow statutory regulations.
Rice___Blast.prevention: Avoid split-application delays of urea, use blast-tolerant seed lots, avoid planting at excessive seedling densities.
Rice___Blast.risk_factors: High night humidity (>90%), daytime temperatures 24–28°C, and cloud cover.

Rice___Brown_spot.organic_treatment: Apply neem seed kernel extract (5%) or Trichoderma harzianum foliar spray. Correct soil potassium and silicon deficiencies.
Rice___Brown_spot.chemical_treatment: Mancozeb (75% WP) or Edifenphos (50% EC) protectant spray according to label timing.
Rice___Brown_spot.prevention: Ensure balanced soil nutrition (NPK + micronutrients); treat seeds with hot water (52°C for 10 min) before sowing.
Rice___Brown_spot.risk_factors: Nutrient-deficient soils, physiological drought stress, and high relative humidity (>85%).

Rice___healthy.organic_treatment: No curative sprays needed. Maintain optimal flood water depth (2–5 cm during tillering) and split nitrogen applications.
Rice___healthy.prevention: Maintain clean bunds, scout weekly for stem borer egg masses, and avoid excessive late-stage urea application.

Wheat___Yellow_rust.organic_treatment: Foliar bio-fungicide (Trichoderma viride or Bacillus subtilis). Ensure adequate potash fertilization to fortify cell walls.
Wheat___Yellow_rust.chemical_treatment: Tebuconazole (25.9% EC) or Propiconazole (25% EC) at first appearance of yellow stripe pustules.
Wheat___Yellow_rust.prevention: Plant resistant cultivars, monitor early winter/spring fields, avoid high seedling density.
Wheat___Yellow_rust.risk_factors: Cool, humid weather (10–15°C with frequent rain or dew).

Wheat___healthy.organic_treatment: No fungicide needed. Maintain recommended irrigation at crown root initiation and flowering stages.
Wheat___healthy.prevention: Continue standard weekly scouting for aphid clusters or early rust pustules on lower leaves.

Soybean___healthy.organic_treatment: No fungicide needed. Maintain standard biological scouting and balanced NPK nourishment.
Soybean___healthy.prevention: Continue regular pest scouting; inspect lower leaf undersides weekly for early pod borer or rust spots.

Tomato___healthy.organic_treatment: No fungicide needed. Ensure regular drip irrigation and calcium supplementation to prevent blossom-end rot.
Tomato___healthy.prevention: Keep foliage dry, apply organic mulch around root base, inspect for hornworms and aphids.

Corn___healthy.organic_treatment: No curative sprays needed. Ensure moisture sufficiency during critical tasseling and silking stages.
Corn___healthy.prevention: Monitor for early armyworm egg masses; maintain weed-free crop borders.

Potato___healthy.organic_treatment: No treatment required. Maintain hilling to protect tubers from greening and tuber moth.
Potato___healthy.prevention: Maintain preventative copper sprays only if regional weather stations announce late blight alert conditions.

General___Foliar_infection.organic_treatment: Prune severely spotted lower leaves. Spray broad-spectrum horticultural copper soap or neem seed extract (1500 ppm). Improve row airflow.
General___Foliar_infection.chemical_treatment: Broad-spectrum contact protectant (Mancozeb or Copper hydroxide class). Follow local label instructions and safety gear mandates.
General___Foliar_infection.prevention: Avoid wetting leaves during watering, rotate crop beds annually, sanitize pruning shears with 70% alcohol.
General___Foliar_infection.risk_factors: Humid stagnant microclimates and dense plant spacing.
